translation: ⟨Your⟩ lovingkindness, O YHWH, ⟨is⟩ in the heavens; ⟨Your⟩ faithfulness ⟨reaches⟩ ⟨to⟩ ⟨the⟩ clouds.

tokens.notes: The word משך can mean 'to draw, extend, reach' - here it's poetically describing God's lovingkindness extending
חסד means lovingkindness/mercy; the suffix 'ך' indicates 'your' (referring to YHWH)
Literally 'to those who know you'; idiomatically rendered as location
Literally 'to the upright'; idiomatically rendered as motion toward
לב literally means 'heart'; here metaphorically for 'clouds' (as in 'heart of the sky')
